An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
